title: The Bleeding Ground
text: The grass is red and wet. The earth is warm underfoot and gives a little, like flesh. Something very big died here a long time ago, and it is dying still. You can feel the slow beat of it through your boots.

options.label: The strongest digs down to whatever lies beneath, hoping to find its heart.

outcomes.text: Beneath the dirt lies a heart, vast and slow, still beating. It is worth a fortune, though the ground moans as it comes free.
It is still alive, a little, and does not wish to be dug up. It reaches up through the earth to say so.

options.label: Cross quickly, and don't look down at what you are standing on.

outcomes.text: You come out red to the knees. All day the warmth stays on your skin, beating faintly.

options.label: The wisest says the rites for the dying thing, so that it may finally rest.

outcomes.text: The ground cools under your feet. The slow beat fades, then stops.
